core_philosophy: Your data belongs to you. The server stores ciphertext, not readable personal information.
modes: Mode 1: Fully Offline Diary (Air-gapped, zero-cloud, SQLite WASM / OPFS)
Mode 2: Portable Encrypted Backups (.fbe container format)
Mode 3: Optional Zero-Knowledge Cloud Sync (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2)

cryptography_spec.key_hierarchy: Envelope Encryption (Master Key -> KEK -> Wrapped DEK)
